programme: NOTCH1 and its native corepressor NCOR1 form the CSL/RBPJ switch that keeps HES1/HEY1 off until Notch signal arrives; TRPS1, a GATA-type repressor that silences RUNX2 (and touches VEGFA/PECAM1), sits on the same repression axis, so the module is a corepressor-gated brake on a RUNX2/HES1-driven proliferative-versus-differentiated fate decision.
role_in_a: In vasculature, NOTCH1-RBPJ signaling maintains contractile smooth-muscle and arterial endothelial identity; when this repression fails, RUNX2-driven osteogenic transdifferentiation of smooth muscle drives calcification, an axis implicated in aortic valve and arterial calcific disease. TRPS1's repression of RUNX2 would reinforce the same brake, and NCOR1 more broadly restrains inflammatory macrophage programmes relevant to plaque biology.
role_in_b: In the colorectal crypt, NOTCH1-HES1 signaling is the master switch holding cells in a proliferative, non-secretory, stem-like state; TRPS1, which Open Targets places near the top of scored genes for rectal cancer here (percentile 0.0682 of 2457), would tune where that differentiation/proliferation balance sits in the tumor epithelium.
shared_axis: A single corepressor logic (NOTCH1/NCOR1, reinforced by TRPS1's repression of RUNX2) toggles a proliferative-versus-differentiated fate decision in two different tissues: contractile-versus-osteogenic in vascular smooth muscle, and stem/proliferative-versus-differentiated in intestinal epithelium.
reasoning: NOTCH1 is independently placed by Open Targets in both diseases and TRPS1 is strongly placed in rectal cancer, so the module is nameable and partly grounded in the record. But NCOR1 — the factor that completes the mechanistic switch — carries no retrieved evidence in either disease, and the record's own summary states no direct evidence was confirmed for any factor in cardiovascular disease, so the CV side of the story rests on general pathway knowledge rather than anything retrieved here.
support: none found — the retrieved PMIDs (23745026 on CREB3L1, 41800265 on POU2F2, 42470525/41440954/40410525/38408896 on CIC) concern other factors in this list, not NOTCH1, NCOR1, or TRPS1.
how_to_falsify: In vascular smooth-muscle cells, activate or silence NOTCH1 and measure NCOR1 occupancy at HES1/HEY1 promoters together with RUNX2-driven calcification markers (ALPL, BGLAP) under a calcification assay; if NCOR1 occupancy and RUNX2 induction do not track Notch activity, the proposed corepressor switch does not operate as claimed. In parallel, knock down TRPS1 in rectal tumor organoids and measure HES1/HEY1 expression and the proliferative-versus-differentiated cell fraction; no shift would refute the shared axis.
caveats: Blood and colorectal tissue are compared at the level of vascular wall versus tumor epithelium, not a shared cell type, so the mechanism is proposed as convergent logic, not a shared cell-autonomous pathway. The 160 patient-group comparisons come from only 6 independent cohort pairs, so the count overstates independent replication. Several TFs common to inflamed blood and epithelium (STAT1/STAT3/STAT5A, IRF1/IRF4/IRF8, CEBPB/CEBPD, NFATC2, RELB, SPIB, TFE3) were removed as tissue-generic, so this account deliberately does not reach for a generic inflammatory story; and single-group-only factors (e.g., TCF7L2, IRF8, POU2F1) are excluded because they did not recur across patient groups.
